title: Browser audio: bounded source memory, eviction and dispose()
description:
Every decoded source is copied into every render worker's wasm heap, up to six workers (`web/src/audio/player.ts:79` and the `copy` near 140). The wasm API has only `rw_renderer_new`, `has_source` and `add_source` (`crates/apricity-web/src/lib.rs:169-188`), with no remove or evict, and `this.loaded` only grows, so browsing many samples in one session grows memory without bound. The gc `setInterval` (`player.ts:94`) is never cleared and there is no `dispose()` to close the AudioContext or terminate workers. `process()` allocates a new `Float32Array` view on every 128-frame quantum (`engine-worklet.ts` near 98), about 375 times a second on the audio thread.

Done when: the wasm API has `remove_source`, the player evicts sources not referenced by the current arrangement, `dispose()` exists and is called on navigation, and the worklet reuses its output view.
